name: Trulieve Cannabis Corp. Subordinate Voting Shares
summary: Trulieve Cannabis Corp. engages in the cultivation, processing, manufacturing, and retail distribution of medical and adult-use cannabis products. It cultivates and produces its products in-house and distributes to its branded stores, as well as directly to patients via home delivery. The company was founded by Kim Rivers & Jason Pernell on September 17, 1940 and is headquartered in Tallahassee, FL.
